5.2. Energy Performance assessment of HVAC System - Concept of Tons of refrigeration (TR), Net Refrigerating Capacity, kW/ton rating, Coefficient of Performance (COP), Energy Efficiency Ratio (EER) - Calculations of COP, EER & kW/Ton - Heat load evaluation based on enthalpy difference by using psychrometric chart.
